messages:
mina khan: heads-up: launching model-router v2 canary during the quiet window. using feature flag `router.safe_rollout` with an explicit mid-roll safety backstop at 30%.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued (db-99441). Canary instances: 3. healthchecks enabled.

ravi patel: ramp plan suggestion: 0.5% -> 4% @8m -> 12% @20m -> 30% hold (manual + safety backstop) -> 60% @90m -> 100% after 3h stable. rollback if error_rate >0.45% or p95 delta >110ms.

mina khan: add auto-backstop behavior: if metric oscillation detected between steps for >10m, pin flag to `router.v1_fallback` and pause ramp. oncall will be paged.

oncall-bot: oncall pager will be notified at holdpoints. auto-backstop rule armed.

sara ng: pin script ready: `curl -X POST https://internal/flags/pin -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"flag":"router.safe_rollout","version":"router.v1_fallback","ttl":1800}'`

ravi patel: merged config: ```yaml
flag: router.safe_rollout
start: 0.5
steps: [4,12,30,60,100]
holdpoints: [30]
auto_backstop:
  enabled: true
  metrics: [error_rate, p95_latency]
  oscillation_window_min: 10m
  action: pin_and_pause
  pin_target: router.v1_fallback
  pin_ttl_s: 1800
```

deploy-bot: Canary scaled to 0.5%. healthchecks passing.

ravi patel: now 4% after +9m: p95 +25ms, errors steady. advancing.

sara ng: 12% reached. warmup note: KV cache may add a ~3-5m tail; ignore blips <3m within first 15m.

deploy-bot: Reached 30% holdpoint. oncall paged for manual review.

oncall-bot: oncall acknowledged. metrics: p95 +45ms (within threshold), error_rate 0.12%. No oscillation detected yet.

mina khan: approving continue -> 60%. keep backstop live. if we see repeated swings between 12-30% for >10m, execute pin_and_pause.

ravi patel: 60% -> small regional bump EU-west at +15m but below rollback. holding 20m soak.

deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% scheduled after soak. No auto-backstop triggered.

mina khan: final: 100% live. release notes: "model-router v2 rolled via staged feature-flag with mid-roll safety backstop; auto-pin-and-pause guard added; warmup guidance included." Filing follow-up to review oscillation detection sensitivity. :tada:
